name: A1_Full_Highlight
description: Preset configuration with A1 tag top AND bottom as separate segments for full highlight control
notes: This preset saves SEGMENT DEFINITIONS, not just colors
When loaded, it reconfigures the segment layout to enable A1 top+bottom control
All other tag tops/bottoms are combined to stay within 16-segment limit
Load this preset when tray A1 is active during printing

segments.name: A1 Tag TOP - ACTIVE
segments.purpose: Active tray A1 TOP highlight - set to filament color
segments.notes: This segment should be set to the active filament color from Spoolman

segments.name: A1 Tag BOTTOM - ACTIVE
segments.purpose: Active tray A1 BOTTOM highlight - set to filament color
segments.notes: This segment should be set to the same filament color as segment 6

segments.name: A2-A4 Tags Top (Inactive Combined)
segments.purpose: Inactive AMS 1 tag tops combined (A2, A3)
segments.notes: Combines A2 (454-465), A3 (466-477) tops. A4 (490-501) is separate or included in hygrometer segment.

segments.name: B1-B4 Tags Top Combined
segments.notes: Combines B1 (579-591), B2 (592-605), B3 (606-619). B4 (632-643) is separate or included in hygrometer segment.

segments.name: A2-A4 Tags Bottom (Inactive Combined)
segments.purpose: Inactive AMS 1 tag bottoms combined (A2, A3, A4)

segments.name: AMS 1 Hygrometer + A4 Tag
segments.notes: Includes hygrometer and A4 tag top which couldn't fit in other segments due to physical layout

segments.name: AMS 2 Hygrometer + B4 Tag
segments.notes: Includes hygrometer and B4 tag top which couldn't fit in other segments due to physical layout

automation_example.action: Load preset 50, then set segments 6 and 7 to filament color

led_ranges_notes: LED ranges are based on digquad-led-segments.md documentation
Some ranges (especially tag bottoms) may need adjustment based on actual strip
Test each segment individually after loading preset to verify correct LEDs light up
If ranges are incorrect, adjust in WLED UI and re-save preset with 'Save segment bounds' enabled
verification_checklist: Turn on only segment 6 - verify A1 top LEDs light up (442-453)
Turn on only segment 7 - verify A1 bottom LEDs light up (502-513)
Verify segments 8-11 correctly combine other tags
Test setting segments 6 and 7 to same color (filament color)
Verify smooth transition when switching from base preset
Test in actual printing scenario with tray A1 active
